evidence_location.quote: Figure 1 is a heat map showing the changes in expression of 63 genes associated with inflammatory responses on the day of the third vaccination and at 24 h and 72 h later.

Real-time polymerase chain reaction.readouts: fold changes in expression of PSME2, PSMB9, PSMB6, and PSMA4

evidence_location.quote: Figure 6A shows reverse-transcriptase polymerase chain reaction confirmation of differential gene expression in 3 randomly chosen samples obtained from protected and not protected outcome groups at 2 weeks after the third vaccination.

malaria thick blood smears.readouts: presence of P. falciparum asexual-stage parasitemia; infection/protection status; delayed onset of parasitemia

evidence_location.quote: Thirty-nine vaccine recipients completed the study, 13 (33%) of whom were protected and 26 (67%) of whom were not protected after challenge. Of the 26 vaccine recipients who were not protected, 11 (28%) had a delayed onset of parasitemia
